sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The aim is to introduce basic concepts and emerging topics in environmental sciences to students by putting emphasis on understanding and critically evaluating research articles.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Demonstrate an understanding of basic concepts in environmental sciences B Demonstrate an understanding of a topic in the frontiers of environmental sciences and propose new research directions C Contribute to a productive discussion of research papers and manuscripts D Identify common pitfalls in research E Compose a paper critique of research papers F Demonstrate an understanding of the manuscript review system, and being able to write a constructive review of manuscripts
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The module will be delivered by self-study and seminars, including activities as follows • Self-study – reading papers & manuscripts • Self-study - writing paper/manuscript reviews and critiques • Seminars - Class paper/manuscript discussions
